blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Authorities failed to arrest a drug suspect, but seized at least P103,000 worth of suspected shabu during a raid in Buenavista, Agusan del Norte, on Tuesday, police said Wednesday. In a statement, the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) said personnel of the Buenavista Municipal Police Station, in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Regional Office 13, served a search warrant in Purok 6, Barangay 7.
